exam.title: Configuring Windows Server Hybrid Advanced Services
exam.study_prerequisites: Several years of Windows Server experience plus practical security hardening, AD DS, failover clustering, Hyper-V, storage, backup and disaster recovery, migration, Azure VM, Azure Monitor, and troubleshooting knowledge.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Secure Windows Server on-premises and hybrid infrastructures
Implement and manage Windows Server high availability
Monitor and troubleshoot Windows Server environments

review.notes: All five canonical October 6, 2025 objective groups and every published subobjective are mapped to requirement, dependency, control, evidence, failure action, and recovery proof, with three integrated scenarios, eight labs, and 24 original knowledge checks. The September 7 pass adds Windows Server and Azure Monitor change feeds and separates unaffected VM Insights performance monitoring from the June 30, 2028 Map and Dependency Agent retirement. The guide retains its retirement, blueprint-weight discrepancy, AMA/DCR, ADMT, and Azure Disk Encryption boundaries. All 87 cited URLs are cataloged: 84 reachable, two O'Reilly books and one Udemy page access-blocked, and none missing.
